name: aurora-host-experiment
description: A small retained-scene host experiment for Aurora.

common.id: optional unique string; derived from the node path when omitted
common.action: optional button action name; emits an action event instead of the default activation event
common.events: optional canvas/surface events (pointer, key, tick) or editor events (change, cursor)
common.tickHz: optional canvas tick rate from 1 to 240; defaults to 0 (disabled)
common.tooltip: optional plain-text hover hint; shown after a short dwell and hidden by popups or pointer exit

menu.items: menu item array with label, shortcut, action, icon, enabled, checked, separator, and children (nested submenu)

tabs.items: tab array with label, action, active, and dirty

textArea.lineNumbers: optional boolean; draw a right-aligned host gutter
textArea.highlightCurrentLine: optional boolean; tint the caret row
textArea.styles: control-channel token color ranges with start, end, and #RRGGBB color

canvas.events: optional pointer, key, tick event list
canvas.commands: rect, roundedRect, line, circle, ring, text, image

image.src: image path relative to the scene file or absolute
image.width: optional preferred width; defaults to source width
image.height: optional preferred height; defaults to source height

surface.path: shared-surface file path relative to the scene file or absolute

styling.common: id, width, height, flex, padding, background, border, radius, style, icon, active, fontSize, textColor, align, and tooltip apply to the node types that support them
styling.themeOverrides: optional scene object overriding palette colors, cornerRadius, borderWidth, controlHeight, fontScale, and spacing
styling.themeColors: windowBackground, panelBackground, panelElevated, text, textMuted, border, accent, accentHover, accentPressed, selection, selectionText, fieldBackground, buttonBackground, buttonHover, buttonPressed, disabled, danger, taskbar, taskbarHover, shadow
styling.contextMenu: textArea and textField accept a menu item array used as their right-click context menu

surface.inputEventLayout: kind:u8, button:u8, key:u16, modifiers:u32, x:i32, y:i32, wheelX:i32, wheelY:i32
surface.frameLayout: two consecutive width*height*4 RGBA8 buffers after header and input ring; active selects the readable buffer

semantics.frame: the writer fills an inactive buffer, sets active, then increments frameSeq; the host copies the active buffer and writes the copied sequence to hostReadSeq; writers may reuse a buffer after hostReadSeq catches up with the frame that used it
semantics.input: the host appends events at inputTail and the external consumer reads from inputHead, advancing inputHead after consuming; head == tail means empty and tail - head == inputCapacity means full
semantics.wheel: kind 4 records pointer position in x/y and wheel deltas in wheelX/wheelY

commands.--version: Print experiment, protocol, and Unicode versions.
commands.--capabilities: Print supported capabilities and scene node types.
commands.--check <scene>: Validate a scene without creating a window.
commands.--render <scene> --out <file.ppm>: Render headlessly to a PPM file.
commands.--run <scene>: Open an Aurora window and run the scene.

commands.status: Window size, renderer, and node count.
commands.tree: List node IDs, types, and text.
commands.setText: Set label, button, or editor text by node ID; notify:false suppresses editor change events.
commands.getText: Read text from a text-editor node by ID.
commands.getEditorState: Read text length, cursor, anchor, line, and column from an editor.
commands.setSelection: Select a Unicode code-point range in an editor and focus it.
commands.setWordWrap: Set word wrapping on a text-editor node.
commands.setEditorView: Set lineNumbers, highlightCurrentLine, and/or a pixel fontSize override on a host text editor.
commands.setEditorStyles: Replace non-overlapping token color ranges on a host text editor.
commands.setCanvas: Replace a canvas node's command list by node ID.
commands.setTick: Set a canvas tick rate by node ID.
commands.setTabs: Replace the tab list on a tabs node by node ID.
commands.setChrome: Update button style, icon, active state, text color, or font size by node ID.
commands.setMenu: Replace a menu node's popup items, including checked and enabled state.
commands.getTabs: Return tab labels, actions, active/dirty flags, and global rectangles.
commands.uiClick: Route a real pointer click through the UI input pipeline at global coordinates.
commands.uiMove: Route a real pointer move through the UI input pipeline at global coordinates.
commands.tooltipState: Report the active hover hint's node, text, visibility, and global rectangle.
commands.menu: Open a menu node's popup menu by node ID.
commands.menuState: Report the open popup menu rectangle, item geometry, and item state.
commands.menuClick: Click a popup menu item by index and verify that the popup closed.
commands.pointer: Inject a pointer event into a canvas or surface.
commands.key: Inject a keyboard event into a canvas or surface.
commands.surface: Report surface mapping, frame sequence, and input ring position.
commands.fileDialog: Open Aurora's generic open/save file dialog and return a path.
commands.click: Activate a button by node ID.
commands.screenshot: Save the current surface as a PPM.
